reviews.comment: She is a great professor, I took this class with my roommate it was super easy. Make sure you do your parts on group projects and you'll get an A. She is funny and very passionate. She will work with you if you have to miss class for important reasons

This class was amazing! Very good class to take if you have a heavy class load and need a filler class. The Tai Chi was super fun and interesting. There are no tests just group projects that are easy as long as you follow the rubric and listen to all of her advice. TAKE this class!

she is very nice, very interesting person to learn from. she doesn't grade harshly but gives very good feedback on how to improve. the tai chi element was very fun. the only days that were mandatory attendance were friday tai chi days and group work days.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Took her for tai chi and learned a lot in addition to never having to worry about my grade. She provides every resource and feedback necessary to learn all of the movements so long as you put in the effort outside of class, which for me was about an hour of practicing the new movements for that week.

Dr. Droleskey is an amazing professor with a very sweet personality. 282 double counts for credit, plus you get to do Tai-chi on Fridays which is just a participation grade. All assignments and quizzes are open note and internet. There are 3 main group projects that weigh your grade, but they're not bad at all if you spend a little time on them.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Taichi with Dr. Droleskey and loved it! This class was such a refuge while battling all the struggles of 2020 and gave me stress-reducing techniques and a fun physical activity I plan to do for the rest of my life. If you attend every class and try your best, she signs a contract to guarantee that you *will* pass. It's a great class and fun!
